requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: Rheinmark Technical University Aachen — Diplom-Ingenieur, Mechanical Engineering, 1999

requirements.note: Degree is in Mechanical Engineering, not electrical engineering, physics, or applied mathematics; whether it counts as a closely adjacent field is left to the recruiter's judgement.

lines.quote: As a Finnish citizen, I hold full EU work authorisation and have no restrictions on employment in Finland or elsewhere in the EU.
Technical writing: internal assembly instructions, maintenance manuals, and customer-facing installation guides, all produced in English (Fenno’s working language since 2003)
Based at Fenno’s Oulu headquarters throughout tenure

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any hands-on experience you have designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms?
Can you describe any experience you have writing production embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ running on real hardware under timing constraints?
Can you describe your experience writing Python to production or engineering standards, such as tested and maintained code used by others?
Can you describe any hands-on RF measurement experience you have, such as with network analysers, spectrum analysers, or anechoic-chamber testing?
